newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3rd qtr business survey index rises - BOK.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3rd qtr business survey index rises - BOK.

text.p: South Korea's business survey index (BSI), a leading forecast of business conditions, stood at 85 for the third quarter of this year, up from 69 for the second quarter, the central Bank of Korea said on Friday.
But the bank said still more than 50 percent of firms surveyed thought their business conditions would worsen in the third quarter as the index was still below 100.
The index shows 100 when positive forecasts balance with negative ones.
The index for the manufacturing sector rose to 92 in the third quarter from 77 the previous quarter, the bank said.
The manufacturing index began to rise for the first time since the second quarter of 1995 when it peaked at 113. The manufacturing index was 64 in the first quarter, the bank said.
The index for non-manufacturers stood at 74 in the third quarter, up from 58 in the second quarter, the bank said.
The manufacturing sector's inventory index stood at 112 for the third quarter, indicating that more than 50 percent of firms surveyed had excessive inventories.
The sector's inventory index was 118 in the second quarter.
The bank said it surveyed 2,480 companies with annual turnover of 500 million won or more.
